output.title: Signature algorithm customization: release note gives no detail
output.content: The release note says only "Allow customizing signature algorithm" with a PR reference. It does not state which resource or field is affected, nor whether existing behavior changes. The environment has cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests and the certificates.cert-manager.io [v1] CRD, but without the field or default involved the intersection cannot be judged. The linked PR #7591 would need to be read to decide.
